# Language State

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:LanguageState`](gmeow-LanguageState.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/LanguageState>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/languages`](../../slices/languages.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified, standpoint-scoped claim about the status of a language, variety, or version during a specific interval — the analytic/historical slice of a language at a time/period, often reconstructed and standpointed. Follows the [`VersionMembership`](gmeow-VersionMembership.md) pattern: a relator binding {language} × {status} × {authority} × {interval}. Differs from [`LanguageVersion`](gmeow-LanguageVersion.md), which is a named/released artifact; a version can have states, and a state can describe a version, but neither is defined as the other.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:LanguageState`](gmeow-LanguageState.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
